exact_definitions.PqxdhDeploymentServerAuthEvent.stepReg:
def stepReg (summary : Summary) : Reg → Summary
  | .create pin keyId owner =>
      { summary with
        owners := summary.owners ++ [(pin, keyId)]
        phases := Function.update summary.phases owner .fresh }
  | .bundle owner (some _) =>
      if summary.phases owner = .fresh then { summary with phases := Function.update summary.phases owner .initSent }
      else summary
  | .bundle owner none =>
      if summary.phases owner = .fresh then { summary with failures := Function.update summary.failures owner true }
      else summary
  | .finish owner _ (some _) =>
      if summary.phases owner = .initSent then
        { summary with phases := Function.update summary.phases owner .established }
      else summary
  | .finish owner _ none =>
      if summary.phases owner = .initSent then { summary with phases := Function.update summary.phases owner .aborted }
      else summary
  | .accept _ _ => summary
  | .build _ _ _ => summary

  | reg :: rest =>
      match reg with
      | .finish owner raw (some _) =>
          if owner = c ∧ summary.phases c = .initSent then some (before, raw)
          else acceptedFrom c (stepReg summary reg) (before ++ [reg]) rest
      | _ => acceptedFrom c (stepReg summary reg) (before ++ [reg]) rest

    Reg.accept acceptRaw (some session) ∈ before ∧ candidateOf codec acceptRaw = some candidate ∧
    acceptedKeys crypto candidate = some keys ∧ publishedKeys codec before owner = some keys ∧
    Reg.build session payload (some reply) ∈ before ∧

exact_definitions.PqxdhDeploymentServerAuthEmbed.embed:
noncomputable def embed (setup : Setup baseSpec KemSK) (codec : Codec Reader Response) (c : Nat) (input : AuthInput) :
    QueryImpl (SourceSpec KemSK) (StateT (Emb KemSK) (OracleComp ServerAuthSpec))
  | .inl (.inl coin) => StateT.lift (ServerAuthSpec.query (.inl coin) : OracleComp ServerAuthSpec _)
  | .inl (.inr (.create pin keyId)) => fun emb =>
      if emb.owners.length = c ∧ emb.slot = .waiting ∧ (pin, keyId) = inputBinding input then
        pure (c, { emb with owners := emb.owners ++ [none], slot := .fresh })
      else
        (fun owner => (emb.owners.length, { emb with
          owners := emb.owners ++ [some owner]
          slot := if emb.owners.length = c ∧ emb.slot = .waiting then .released else emb.slot })) <$>
          coins (localCreate setup pin keyId)
  | .inl (.inr (.bundle index)) => fun emb =>
      match emb.owners[index]? with
      | none => pure (none, emb)
      | some none =>
          if emb.slot = .fresh then
            pure (input.phase1, { emb with slot := if input.phase1.isSome then .bundled else .failed })
          else pure (none, emb)
      | some (some owner) =>
          (fun result => (result.1, { emb with owners := emb.owners.set index (some result.2) })) <$>
            coins (localBundle setup codec index owner)
  | .inl (.inr (.accept raw)) => StateT.lift (forward (.accept raw))
  | .inl (.inr (.build session payload)) => StateT.lift (forward (.build session payload))
  | .inl (.inr (.finish index raw)) => fun emb =>
      match emb.owners[index]? with
      | none => pure (none, emb)
      | some none =>
          if emb.slot = .bundled then (fun reply => (reply, emb)) <$> forward (.finish raw)
          else pure (none, emb)
      | some (some owner) =>
          (fun result => (result.1, { emb with owners := emb.owners.set index (some result.2) })) <$>
            simulateQ (localCallbacks setup codec) (PqxdhBeaconPhase2Publication.nativeOwner codec.frameRead raw owner)
  | .inl (.inr (.hmac key message)) => StateT.lift (forward (.hmac key message))
  | .inl (.inr (.hash bytes)) => StateT.lift (forward (.hash bytes))
  | .inl (.inr (.reveal keyId)) => StateT.lift (forward (.reveal keyId))
  | .inr (index, field) => fun emb =>
      pure ((emb.owners[index]?).bind fun slot => slot.bind (PqxdhRegistrationJointLiveRead.value field), emb)

  if summary.owners.length ≤ c then .waiting

exact_definitions.PqxdhDeploymentServerAuthTrack.Track:
structure Track (c : Nat) (input : AuthInput) (regs : List Reg) (emb : Emb KemSK) (log : QueryLog ServerAuthSpec) :
    Prop where
  count : emb.owners.length = (summarizeReg regs).owners.length
  target : ∀ index, emb.owners[index]? = some none ↔
    index = c ∧ (summarizeReg regs).owners[c]? = some (inputBinding input)
  slot : emb.slot = slotOf c input (summarizeReg regs)
  beyond : ∀ index, (summarizeReg regs).owners.length ≤ index →
    (summarizeReg regs).phases index = .absent ∧ (summarizeReg regs).failures index = false ∧
      bundleOfReg regs index = none
  created : ∀ index, index < (summarizeReg regs).owners.length → (summarizeReg regs).phases index ≠ .absent
  fresh : (summarizeReg regs).owners[c]? = some (inputBinding input) → (summarizeReg regs).phases c = .fresh →
    bundleOfReg regs c = none
  sent : (summarizeReg regs).owners[c]? = some (inputBinding input) → (summarizeReg regs).failures c = false →
    (summarizeReg regs).phases c ≠ .fresh → bundleOfReg regs c = input.phase1 ∧ input.phase1.isSome = true
  logged : ∀ entry ∈ log, ∀ reg, saReg c entry = some reg → reg ∈ regs
  finished : ∀ entry ∈ log, ∀ raw reply, saReg c entry = some (.finish c raw reply) →
    (summarizeReg regs).owners[c]? = some (inputBinding input) ∧
      (reply.isSome = true → (accepted c regs).isSome = true ∨ (summarizeReg regs).phases c = .aborted ∨
        (summarizeReg regs).phases c = .established)
  accepted : ∀ before raw, accepted c regs = some (before, raw) →
    (summarizeReg before).owners[c]? = some (inputBinding input) →
    ∃ prior payload, log = prior ++ [⟨.inr (.finish raw), some payload⟩] ∧
      (∀ entry ∈ prior, ∀ reg, saReg c entry = some reg → reg ∈ before) ∧
      (∀ entry ∈ prior, ∀ raw' payload', saReg c entry ≠ some (.finish c raw' (some payload'))) ∧
      bundleOfReg before c = input.phase1

exact_definitions.PqxdhDeploymentServerAuthInjective.colli:
noncomputable def collider (count : Nat) (publics : Fin (count + 1) → PublicIdentity) :
    OracleComp (PqxdhJointIdentityFamily.FamilyAdversarySpec (count + 1))
      (PqxdhJointIdentityFamily.FamilyForgery (count + 1)) := by
  classical
  exact if collision : ∃ pair : Fin (count + 1) × Fin (count + 1),
      pair.1 ≠ pair.2 ∧ (publics pair.1).ed25519 = (publics pair.2).ed25519 then
    (fun signature => ⟨(Classical.choose collision).2, ⟨[], signature⟩⟩) <$>

        (.inr ((Classical.choose collision).1, .sign []))) :
          OracleComp (PqxdhJointIdentityFamily.FamilyAdversarySpec (count + 1)) PqxdhEd25519EufCma.Ed25519Signature)
  else
    (fun signature => ⟨0, ⟨[], signature⟩⟩) <$>
      (liftM ((PqxdhJointIdentityFamily.FamilyAdversarySpec (count + 1)).query (.inr (0, .sign []))) :
        OracleComp (PqxdhJointIdentityFamily.FamilyAdversarySpec (count + 1)) PqxdhEd25519EufCma.Ed25519Signature)

deviations_from_plan: Public matching, a smaller event than planned. The plan states CE-A1 with an eleven-field common session that published the decoded record earlier. CE-A1 is stated with a public relation instead: MatchedAt (an accept of the session on bytes whose raw candidate the source attached verification accepts with the identity key and key tuple of the Beacon's first published bundle, and an earlier build of the session with the accepted decoded record) and, in the headlines, PinnedMatchAt (the same with the Server identity of the build reply equal to the Beacon's pin). This relation is weaker than the eleven-field agreement: root_failure proves only that the public A1 failure implies the ServerAuth common authentication failure on the same run (an eleven-field common session that published the record gives a public match), not the converse, so the bounded event is a sub-event of the planned failure. It states no root agreement and nothing about the KEM ciphertext or the ephemeral key of the accepted response, so it does not give the section 9 Beacon-side ciphertext link (not_proved). The first-pass receipt called this a restatement, not a weakening, and said that the public failure is the ServerAuth failure; both statements were wrong and are withdrawn.

NoBundleFailure_c (section 19 option (b)): ce_a1 uses NoBundleFailureAt on the whole run (A1NoFailure, and A1NoPinnedMatch in the headlines); the per-index theorems use the weaker condition before the acceptance (A1At), which it implies (noFailure_a1At).
The sum over Beacons is over c < qCreate (a1_range), not qCreate + 1; the injectivity sum is over qCreate + 1 identity indices as planned.

B^coll_t is the family reduction of the collision finder, which makes exactly one signing query through the family oracle (collider_queries; routed to the challenger only when the signing identity is the target), so B^coll_t makes at most one signing query (collider_bills), not zero as plan section 10 and owner input 17 describe. The game is the approved joint-use weak-EUF game with its signing oracle; no new assumption. Owner confirmation of this deviation is pending.
The per-index and summed theorems hold at every identity index; session_unique, injective_bound and ce_a1_injective are at identity index 0, the index of the CE-9 trace invariant.
R_c caps charge each local finish its full 69-callback allowance (hash, HMAC and decapsulation coins per callback); upper bounds, not exact counts.

contracts_used: The premises of generated_authentication / common_authentication_with_resources: X25519ClassLaw, X25519ScalarSpread, SourceFullCorrect, HasAttachedVerificationAdapter, ReadWritable, Phase2ReadBack, FrameReadBack and KemBound setup caps; the bound charges Gap-DH, the R1 Extract and BLAKE2b random oracles (through serverGapDhAdvantage and the record/schedule losses), recordLoss (by recordLoss_expanded: three AEAD IND$ advantages, 2 x the AEAD INT-CTXT advantage, (2H + 1)/2^128 + 1/2^512), scheduleLoss (three HMAC-PRF advantages and two Extract-on-uniform advantages) and joint-use weak-EUF. not_proved: The section 9 Beacon-side corollary: CE-A1 does not give the ciphertext conjunct of CE-5 Linked (the matched build reply carries the ciphertext of c's accepted finish input). It is not provable at the CE-A1 bound (review_fix_pass.not_done); closing it needs a KEM step (for example a per-target IND-CCA reduction for acceptance of a matched session's record under a different ciphertext with the same decapsulated key, adding loss terms to eps_A1, a plan change for the owner) or a different Beacon-side designation. The plan's section 9 justification (the eleven fields carry the ciphertext) is wrong: Session has no ciphertext field and the root input carries the KEM shared secret.
Root, associated-data and registration-ID agreement of the matched session: the outcome of the experiment keeps no root; not needed by the section 9 eligibility.
